seen_before_freeze: ID01 CSV displayed by web retrieval to inspect format. No ID07–54 responses inspected or scored.
preprocessing: Read CSV; sort frequencies increasing; use every finite positive-frequency record, no quadrant filtering. Require44 rows; reject missing/duplicate/nonfinite points.
relaxation_tau_bounds: 2 decades beyond reciprocal angular-frequency endpoints; tau_min=.01/(2*pi*fmax), tau_max=100/(2*pi*fmin)
model_selection: Fit only train observations; validation complex relative RMS chooses candidate; exact ties lower order/complexity. Do not refit. Primary test scores only after selection. No instability-based candidate exclusion.
secondary_metric: max absolute complex impedance error in Ohm
uncertainty: 10000 seeded paired device-bootstrap resamples over48 confirmation cells. Within each scenario/budget compare per-device log(error ratio) and mean absolute error difference. No frequency-wise pseudo-replication. Shared batch/instrument systematic errors unaccounted.
baseline_limits: VF stable poles do not imply passive coefficients. Convergence warnings retained. NNLS is existing passive relaxation physics prior, not a uniquev5 algorithm.
conjugate_augmentation: Loewner appends negative-frequency conjugates from real-system symmetry; not new measurements.
data_selection: All54cellfiles, no outcome-based selection; IDs01–06 excluded from confirmation.
failure_policy: Record all exceptions and nonfinite predictions. If any selected-method failure occurs, summarize failures explicitly; paired comparison only on common successful devices plus coverage.
confirmation_devices_independence: Separate physicalcells in one batch at oneSoC on oneinstrument, not multiple laboratories or repeatednew experiments.

mandatory_failure_sensitivity.report: Mandatory paired all48-device bootstrap using capped errors, alongside common-success comparisons and explicit coverage. Added after independent protocol review before any benchmark execution.
